contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ SALONINA AVG ; R/ VENVS VICTRIX

Copper alloy coin. Silvered radiate of Salonina (joint reign with Gallienus, 260-268), Reece period 13, mint of Rome, cf. RIC volume 5 part 1 no. 13. Obverse description: Lunate bust coiffed and draped right. Obverse inscription: SALONINA AVG. Reverse description: Venus standing left draped with spear and shield, right arm extended. Reverse inscription: VENVS VICTRIX. Diameter: 19.5mm, Weight: 2.46gms, die axis: 12
